title: The venue is right off of...
text: The venue is right off of the main tourist hub on La Rambla. I opted for the middle row section with an included cocktail. There truly isn’t a bad seat in the house. The performances were mesmerizing with their magnificent footwork and costuming. There is a designated time towards the end of the performance to take photos and video which was great greatly appreciated.
